description:
Studio Flat | Redland | Fully Furnished | Council Tax & Water Included | Communal Laundry Facilities | Available 11th September 2026

Key Features: 

Fully furnished studio flat

Popular Redland location

Council tax included in the rent

Water and sewerage included

Open-plan kitchen/living/bedroom area

Separate shower room

Electric heating

Free use of communal washing machines and tumble dryers

Virgin Media available for £7 per month with no annual contract

First-come, first-served parking

On-street parking also available

EPC Rating C

Available 11th September 2026

Deposit £1153.84

Bristol Property Centre are delighted to offer to the market this well-presented, fully furnished studio flat, situated in the highly sought-after area of Redland.

The property is located on Coldharbour Road, with access from Dundonald Road, and offers a practical open-plan kitchen, living and sleeping area, along with a separate shower room.

The studio is offered fully furnished and benefits from electric heating. Residents also have free use of communal washing machines and tumble dryers within the building.

For added convenience, the rent includes council tax, water and sewerage. Virgin Media is also available for an additional £7 per month, with no annual contract required.

Parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis, with additional on-street parking available nearby.

Available from 11th September 2026.

EPC Rating: C
Parking: First come, first served / on-street parking

Please contact Bristol Property Centre to arrange your viewing.
